$comment: Canonical Drums MCP tool list. Both servers (gateway /gw/mcp in TypeScript, `drums mcp` stdio in Python) load this file verbatim and must list exactly these tools with exactly these inputSchemas. `scope` is the API-key scope the gateway requires; `destructive` tools require `confirm: true`; `layer` is workspace or desktop. Desktop tools take `computer_id` (the Python server fills it from --env when bound).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the templates (base desktop images) this workspace can start a computer from. Use a template's `checkpoint` as the `template` argument of create_computer.

tools.name: list_computers
tools.description: List the live computers (desktops) of this workspace: id, name, state, validity, task, created_at. Pass include_destroyed to also see closed ones.

tools.name: create_computer
tools.description: Start a new isolated desktop (computer) from a template or a snapshot, optionally with a task loaded. Returns the computer record; its `id` is the computer_id every desktop tool takes. The desktop is ready when state is `ready` and validity is `valid`.

template.description: A template checkpoint from list_templates (for example osworld-ubuntu) or a snapshot id from list_snapshots.

task_id.description: A task id from list_tasks to load into the desktop at start (its setup runs before the episode).

task.description: A full task document (OSWorld format) instead of task_id.

ttl_s.description: Lifetime in seconds; the computer is closed when it expires (0 or absent: the workspace default).

setup.description: Run the task's setup (default true when a task is given).

tools.name: get_computer
tools.description: Read one computer's record: state, validity verdict and reasons, task, lease, epoch.

tools.name: destroy_computer
tools.description: Close a computer for good (its desktop state is lost). Destructive: the call is refused unless confirm is true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Say so to the user before destroying.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List the saved desktop states (snapshots) of this workspace. A snapshot id can be the `template` of create_computer.

tools.name: create_snapshot
tools.description: Save a computer's current desktop state as a snapshot (the computer keeps running). Returns the snapshot record.

tools.name: delete_snapshot
tools.description: Delete a snapshot. Destructive: refused unless confirm is true.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the verified computer-use tasks available on this host (id, domain, instruction). Load one with create_computer(task_id) or load_task.

domain.description: Filter by domain (for example chrome, os, libreoffice_calc).

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task document (instruction, setup, checker).

tools.name: load_task
tools.description: Load a task into a running computer (runs its setup and starts a new episode). After this, `verify` scores the desktop against this task's checker.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List the runs (training, scripted tests) of this workspace, newest first: id, name, kind, status, counts.

status.description: Filter by status (queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled).

tools.name: create_run
tools.description: Submit a run (RunSpec: name, kind, task_set_id, task_ids, template_version_id, agent, execution, budget). It is queued and the host's runner picks it up. Returns run_id and operation_id.

spec.description: The RunSpec, the same document the console's New run form submits.

idempotency_key.description: Resubmitting with the same key returns the same run.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Read a run's status and results: status, stop reason, attempt counts (done, succeeded, verified valid), metrics and the last events.

tools.name: list_evaluations
tools.description: List evaluation runs of this workspace, newest first.

tools.name: create_evaluation
tools.description: Submit an evaluation (a run with kind evaluation): the same RunSpec as create_run; `kind` is set to evaluation.

tools.name: get_evaluation
tools.description: Read an evaluation's status and results (per-task success and verified validity).

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List this workspace's API keys (metadata only: id, name, prefix, scopes, created, last used, expiry; never a secret).

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create an API key in this workspace. The plaintext key is in this reply once and nowhere else. Scopes cannot exceed the calling key's own scopes.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key; it is refused on its next call. Destructive: refused unless confirm is true.

tools.name: read_audit_log
tools.description: Read this workspace's audit log, newest first: who did what, when, with what outcome. MCP calls appear with actor mcp and action mcp.<tool>.

action.description: Filter by action prefix, for example mcp or computer.create.

tools.name: gui
tools.description: Run a GUI action in the desktop: Python using pyautogui (e.g. pyautogui.click(100, 200), pyautogui.write('text'), pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's')). Screen is 1920x1080 pixels. Take a screenshot afterwards to see the result.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the desktop (PNG image).

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a bash command in the desktop as the desktop user (no root, no internet). Returns returncode, stdout, stderr.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file in the desktop (~ is /home/user). Text comes back as text, binary as base64.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a text file in the desktop (creates folders; overwrites).

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List a folder in the desktop: name, dir, size.

tools.name: office_convert
tools.description: Convert a document with LibreOffice (e.g. docx->pdf, xlsx->csv, csv->xlsx). Writes next to the source unless outdir is given.

tools.name: spreadsheet_read
tools.description: Read the first sheet of a spreadsheet (xlsx, ods, csv) as rows of text, through LibreOffice.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List the open Chrome tabs (url, title). Needs Chrome started with --remote-debugging-port=1337.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a URL in a new Chrome tab (Chrome must be running with --remote-debugging-port=1337).

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Score the desktop's current state with the loaded task's checker: score (0..1), valid (every gate of the episode passed), trusted, audit flags.

tools.name: fork
tools.description: Fork a running desktop into n children that each continue from this exact state (apps open, files as they are). Returns the children's computer ids. The parent keeps running.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Reset a desktop to its clean template state and start a new episode (the loaded task's setup runs again).
